64:t_005:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What a splendid takeoff...! I see that's one highly skilled pilot!」

64:t_005:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I wonder where Fleet Leader $$フェアロック$$ is? I want to crush him as soon as I can.」

64:t_005:2.en:
$$レド$$
[Chamber! We're going after that one!]

64:t_006:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「So you've come. The $$ユンボロ$$ that drove off the $$サイデリアル$$.」

64:t_006:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「But you aren't the only one with a special $$ユンボロ$$.」

64:t_006:2.en:
$$ルカ$$
「That $$ユンボロ$$...! Its performance is nothing like the other pirates'!」

64:t_006:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Rumor has it that thing was modified with technology from outside the $$残されの海$$!」

64:t_006:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「An opponent who's dangerous if we lower our guard, then.」

64:t_006:5.en:
$n
「Above all, the presence of that rumored lady pirate... We can't underestimate her!」

64:t_006:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So that's the Empress of the $$残されの海$$...」

64:t_006:7.en:
$$海賊$$
「We're counting on you, $$ラケージ$$!」

64:t_006:8.en:
$$海賊$$
「Please crush those guys for us!」

64:t_006:9.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Now, come. I shall show you who the master of this sea is.」

64:t_006:10.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, set your attack target to the enemy commander unit! Please follow the plan from the pre-battle meeting!」

64:t_007:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Gh...! How could this happen to me...!」

64:t_008:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Remember this. I'll come back as many times as it takes! Until I've taken this fleet!」

64:t_009:1.en:
$$パリヌリ$$
「We've come to pick you up!」

64:t_009:2.en:
$$リジット$$
「If it ends like this, there will be fighting again...!」

64:t_009:3.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「$$リジット$$... Let's believe in her... in Captain $$テスタロッサ$$.」

64:t_009:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, hold the pirates back!」

64:t_010:1.en:
$$レド$$
[Enemy unit captured! Surfacing with it!]

64:t_011:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「To lift up my own $$ユンボロ$$...!」

64:t_011:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Attention, occupant. Surrender at once.」

64:t_011:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Surrender. We guarantee your life's safety.」

64:t_011:4.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「You're persistent. No matter how many times you ask, I will never surrender! Not even if it means death!」

64:t_011:5.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「So that is her answer, as expected.」

64:t_011:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Then we will settle this in the sea, the source of her pride.」

64:t_011:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Ensign $$レド$$, signal confirmed from the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.]

64:t_012:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I will show you who the master of the sea... who the Empress is!」

64:t_012:3.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye aye, ma'am! Full speed ahead!」

64:t_013:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I am the Empress of this sea!!」

64:t_015:0.en:
$$パラエム$$
「L-$$ラケージ$$ lost at sea!」

64:t_015:1.en:
$$パリヌリ$$
「What the heck!? Is a ship traveling underwater even allowed!?」

64:t_015:2.en:
$$パラエム$$
「It's not a ship! No ship could move at that speed!」

64:t_015:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Now admit it! Admit who the Empress of the sea is!」

64:t_015:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I... $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$, and the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ are the new Empress of the $$残されの海$$!」

64:t_015:8.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「$$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$! I'll remember that name!!」

64:t_016:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「All enemy units have withdrawn.」

64:t_017:0.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You were so cool, $$テッサ$$.」

64:t_017:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「You overwhelm the pirate $$ラケージ$$ in the sea, her home turf, and strip her of her charisma...」

64:t_017:3.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「At the same time, by taking away the Empress title she holds, you make her turn her anger on $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$ personally... Superb, Captain.」

64:t_017:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「No... The operation's success is thanks to everyone's efforts, starting with Ensign $$レド$$.」

64:t_017:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「And it was you, Captain, who led them.」

64:t_017:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yo! The new Empress of the $$残されの海$$!」

64:t_017:7.en:
$$マオ$$
「I fell for you all over again, $$テッサ$$!」

64:t_017:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'll follow you for life, Empress $$テッサ$$!」

64:t_017:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Oh, stop it! Don't tease me!」

64:t_017:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[A logical explanation is impossible. Compared to the unit we belonged to, there is a great gap in everything: organization, personnel, strategic objectives, and more.]

64:t_017:12.en:
$$アル$$
「But Chamber... you two are now members of this $c.」

64:t_017:15.en:
$n
「$$レド$$... We came to this planet to fight the $$サイデリアル$$.」

64:t_017:16.en:
$n
「If you're willing, why not come with us?」

64:t_018:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Communication from the fleet.]

64:t_018:1.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Thank you, $$レド$$! Thank you, $c!」

64:t_018:2.en:
$$レド$$
[Thank you... It's a phrase I keep hearing.]

64:t_018:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[It is an idiom signifying gratitude.]
